title: Changing course: Glucose starvation drives nuclear accumulation of Hexokinase 2 in S. cerevisiae.
authors: Lesko, Mitchell A; Chandrashekarappa, Dakshayini G; Jordahl, Eric M; Oppenheimer, Katherine G; Bowman, Ray W 2nd; Shang, Chaowei; Durrant, Jacob D; Schmidt, Martin C; O'Donnell, Allyson F
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母Hxk2在葡萄糖饥饿下核定位的调控机制，涉及蛋白二聚化与核转运，但核心是代谢酶而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅建模提供有限机制见解，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Glucose is the preferred carbon source for most eukaryotes, and the first step in its metabolism is phosphorylation to glucose-6-phosphate. This reaction is catalyzed by hexokinases or glucokinases. The yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae encodes three such enzymes, Hxk1, Hxk2, and Glk1. In yeast and mammals, some isoforms of this enzyme are found in the nucleus, suggesting a possible moonlighting function beyond glucose phosphorylation. In contrast to mammalian hexokinases, yeast Hxk2 has been proposed to shuttle into the nucleus in glucose-replete conditions, where it reportedly moonlights as part of a glucose-repressive transcriptional complex. To achieve its role in glucose repression, Hxk2 reportedly binds the Mig1 transcriptional repressor, is dephosphorylated at serine 15 and requires an N-terminal nuclear localization sequence (NLS). We used high-resolution, quantitative, fluorescent microscopy of live cells to determine the conditions, residues, and regulatory proteins required for Hxk2 nuclear localization. Countering previous yeast studies, we find that Hxk2 is largely excluded from the nucleus under glucose-replete conditions but is retained in the nucleus under glucose-limiting conditions. We find that the Hxk2 N-terminus does not contain an NLS but instead is necessary for nuclear exclusion and regulating multimerization. Amino acid substitutions of the phosphorylated residue, serine 15, disrupt Hxk2 dimerization but have no effect on its glucose-regulated nuclear localization. Alanine substation at nearby lysine 13 affects dimerization and maintenance of nuclear exclusion in glucose-replete conditions. Modeling and simulation provide insight into the molecular mechanisms of this regulation. In contrast to earlier studies, we find that the transcriptional repressor Mig1 and the protein kinase Snf1 have little effect on Hxk2 localization. Instead, the protein kinase Tda1 regulates Hxk2 localization. RNAseq analyses of the yeast transcriptome dispels the idea that Hxk2 moonlights as a transcriptional regulator of glucose repression, demonstrating that Hxk2 has a negligible role in transcriptional regulation in both glucose-replete and limiting conditions. Our studies define a new model of cis- and trans-acting regulators of Hxk2 dimerization and nuclear localization. Based on our data, the nuclear translocation of Hxk2 in yeast occurs in glucose starvation conditions, which aligns well with the nuclear regulation of mammalian orthologs. Our results lay the foundation for future studies of Hxk2 nuclear activity.
abstract_zh: 葡萄糖是大多数真核生物的首选碳源，其代谢的第一步是磷酸化为葡萄糖-6-磷酸。该反应由己糖激酶或葡萄糖激酶催化。酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae）编码三种此类酶：Hxk1、Hxk2和Glk1。在酵母和哺乳动物中，该酶的某些同工型存在于细胞核中，提示其可能具有超越葡萄糖磷酸化的兼职功能。与哺乳动物己糖激酶不同，酵母Hxk2被认为在葡萄糖充足条件下穿梭进入细胞核，据报道其在其中作为葡萄糖抑制转录复合物的一部分发挥兼职作用。为实现其在葡萄糖抑制中的角色，Hxk2据报道与Mig1转录抑制因子结合，在丝氨酸15位点去磷酸化，并需要N端核定位序列（NLS）。我们使用活细胞的高分辨率、定量荧光显微镜来确定Hxk2核定位所需的条件、残基和调控蛋白。与先前酵母研究相反，我们发现Hxk2在葡萄糖充足条件下主要被排除在细胞核外，但在葡萄糖限制条件下则保留在细胞核内。我们发现Hxk2的N端不包含NLS，而是对核排除和调控多聚化所必需。磷酸化残基丝氨酸15的氨基酸替换破坏了Hxk2二聚化，但对其葡萄糖调控的核定位无影响。邻近赖氨酸13的丙氨酸替换影响二聚化以及在葡萄糖充足条件下维持核排除。建模和模拟为这种调控的分子机制提供了见解。与早期研究相反，我们发现转录抑制因子Mig1和蛋白激酶Snf1对Hxk2定位影响甚微。相反，蛋白激酶Tda1调控Hxk2定位。酵母转录组的RNAseq分析驳斥了Hxk2作为葡萄糖抑制转录调控因子兼职的观点，表明Hxk2在葡萄糖充足和限制条件下对转录调控的作用可忽略不计。我们的研究定义了Hxk2二聚化和核定位的顺式及反式调控因子的新模型。基于我们的数据，酵母中Hxk2的核转位发生在葡萄糖饥饿条件下，这与哺乳动物同源物的核调控高度一致。我们的结果为未来Hxk2核活性研究奠定了基础。
